segments.name: Real Estate
segments.description: Acquires, owns, and manages primarily single-tenant industrial and office properties leased to diversified tenants across the United States.
segments.evidence: We focus on acquiring, owning, and managing primarily industrial and office properties.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under net leases of approximately seven to twenty years with built-in rental increases, covering most operating costs, taxes and insurance.
revenueModel.evidence: We have historically entered into, and intend in the future to enter into, purchase agreements for real estate having net leases with terms of approximately seven to 20 years with built-in rental rate increases.
